knowledge_gaps: The residual is underspecified: smoothing, frequency normalization, reliability weighting, clipping, neighborhood pruning, recency weights, gate bounds and initialization all need explicit formulas and hyperparameters. Missing edges receiving zero also needs reconciliation with smoothed log-lift.

A graph built from all training histories includes the transitions used as training targets. This is permitted training-data reuse, but singleton edges can create a memorization shortcut and inflate training diagnostics. The report needs controls that distinguish shared transition evidence from target self-counting.

The diagnostic scoring interface supplies features and candidate items, whereas the proposed residual also needs recent item IDs. The report must explain how context reaches the complete scorer consistently during training, diagnosis, candidate evaluation and full-catalog recommendation.

There is no measured baseline validation HR@10, graph coverage or runtime evidence supporting the potential and difficulty ratings. The evaluation plan also lacks a budgeted ablation schedule and protection against repeated validation selection. Unavailable metadata category breakdowns should be reported as unavailable.
